verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the skills are installed as Claude Code skills or `.claude/skills/` folders and invoked explicitly by slash command (/replica-backend, /replica-entrepreneur) in a prescribed order. Nothing documents descriptions written to make the agent activate the right skill automatically from task context. Any auto-activation Claude Code's skill system might provide is a host-platform capability, not one this product documents.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment
